description: Backfill and keep current the PRS four-axis ratings (pri/sev/appeal/effort, 1-100) on registered roadmap rows that are still unrated. Trigger on "/prs-backfill", "backfill PRS ratings", "rate the unrated issues", or a scheduled enrichment pass. A deterministic script inventories open issues against releases.db and builds bounded evidence packets; the agent proposes scores and a dated rationale under the start-task rating policy; an independent reviewer (different agent/model) must agree; the script freezes a hashed plan, and the operator's approval of that hash authorizes writes through `releases roadmap rate` only - never --force, never --ovr. Also runs the E0 blind calibration against already-rated rows. Does not register issues, write capture docs, admit work to Jog, or re-score rated rows. Requires gh, python3, releases.db at the repo root.
